title: Choose the student that fits the deployment contract
description: Compare illustrative measurements from the same holdout set and exported runtime. A candidate qualifies for a canary only when every quality and system gate passes.

profiles.label: Browser WASM CPU
profiles.detail: Interactive, single-example inference on a memory-constrained client.

profiles.label: Edge GPU
profiles.detail: Batch-one inference with a strict response-time budget.

profiles.label: Server CPU
profiles.detail: A latency-sensitive service with a stronger aggregate quality floor.

candidates.label: Qualified teacher
candidates.detail: Highest quality, but its inference footprint exceeds several target profiles.

candidates.label: Balanced student
candidates.detail: Moderate compression with quality and runtime measurements near the teacher.

candidates.label: Tiny student
candidates.detail: Fast and small, but its aggregate and worst-slice quality fall below every profile.

candidates.label: Slice-guarded student
candidates.detail: Protects the weakest slice, but its latency or overall score blocks some profiles.
